name: apkstart
description: 极致轻量的 Windows 安卓应用运行器：双击 APK 即装，应用以独立窗口与桌面图标运行
author: MoonlyCake

scripts.test: node test/run-tests.js && node test/android-test.js && node test/range-validation-test.js && node test/display-scale-test.js && node test/resources-test.js && node test/drivers-test.js && node test/preflight-test.js && node test/standalone-test.js && node test/boot-auth-test.js && node test/issue-hardening-test.js && node test/autodebug-test.js && node test/settings-categories-test.js && node test/engine-test.js && node test/manual-test.js && node test/incremental-test.js && node test/auto-test.js && npm run test:rewrite
scripts.test:rewrite: node --test test/rewrite-queue.test.js test/rewrite-launch.test.js test/rewrite-state.test.js test/rewrite-audio.test.js test/rewrite-ownership.test.js test/phase2-bundle.test.js test/rewrite-ipc.test.js test/rewrite-runtime-lifecycle.test.js test/rewrite-sessions.test.js test/rewrite-replay.test.js test/aehd-package.test.js test/rewrite-ipc-failure.test.js test/rewrite-resource-policy.test.js test/rewrite-leftovers.test.js test/desktop-launch.test.js test/startup-modules.test.js test/adb-transport.test.js test/rewrite-update-channel.test.js test/rewrite-emulator-boot-data.test.js test/rewrite-native-abi.test.js
scripts.build:exe: node build/prepare-runtime.js && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:appx: node build/prepare-runtime.js && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:all: node build/pack.js && node build/pack.js --full && node build/msix.js
